recent_news: Linear is actively hiring, with 17 open roles listed on their careers page and plans to open more positions in the second half of the year. (Source: https://www.businessinsider.com/linear-cofounder-hiring-ai-driven-layoffs-joke-2026-5)

culture_signals: Linear is known for its speed-obsessed engineering teams, keyboard-first UX, and focus on craft and quality in software development. They prioritize building a better product over inventing new things. The company operates with a remote-first approach and has a deliberate geographic distribution across North America and Europe. (Source: https://newsletter.pragmaticengineer.com/p/linear, https://www.techinterview.org/companies/linear)
The company's pace is described as deliberate, neither frantic startup nor slow enterprise. (Source: https://www.techinterview.org/companies/linear)
No specific information found regarding diversity and inclusion initiatives.

No specific information found regarding career development and growth, but the company emphasizes hiring people who embody their engineering culture and care about the craft of software. (Source: https://newsletter.pragmaticengineer.com/p/linear)

Linear publishes its compensation philosophy publicly, with transparent location adjustments that are smaller than many remote-first companies. They offer private-company equity valued at 2024 Series C marks, with a 4-year vest and 1-year cliff. (Source: https://www.techinterview.org/companies/linear)

Linear's mission is to inspire and accelerate builders. Their core principles include shipping early, building with users, knowing what good looks like, thinking in principles, and building things that last. (Source: https://linear.app/careers)

Linear is a design-driven company that focuses on building a polished product. They are known for saying 'no' to most feature requests to maintain focus and avoid product bloat.
